title: Run the authorized visible Feishu egress and idempotency qualification

authorization.text: 允许测试；使用 larksuite/cli 操控进行测试

in_scope: Resolve the existing exact video-factory group binding without exposing its raw chat ID
Dry-run and then send one Markdown, PNG, TXT, and MP4-with-cover message
Retry each same artifact with the same idempotency key and record the result
out_of_scope: Starting lark-cli event or any second inbound consumer
Sending to any recipient other than the configured target group

verification.target_resolution: PASS: exact OpenClaw VideoFactory group name match count 1; raw chat ID not recorded
verification.dry_run: PASS: Markdown, PNG, TXT, MP4+cover all exit 0 with no actual message IDs
verification.actual_send: PASS: all four artifact types returned ok=true and a message ID
verification.idempotency_replay: PASS: all four same-key retries returned the same message ID
verification.external_state: PASS within authorization: only the four visible test messages were sent; no event listener, second consumer, configuration, OAuth, or profile change
